policies.detail: Independent Placement option is for applicants who find their own host. A separate Premium Placement option exists for hospitality only, for a fee that is not published.

requirements.description: Generally a full-time student, or graduated within the last 12 months, from a post-secondary institution outside the U.S., with a degree in the same field as the internship.
Generally a degree plus at least one year of related full-time experience, or five years of experience, gained outside the U.S.
Online or distance-learning degrees do not qualify. Most programs cannot support J-2 spouses and dependents.
Not sponsored: housekeeping, bartending, valet driving, receptionist, counter-service dining, machinery operation, retail, amusement parks, water parks.

fee_schedules.notes: No fee is due until after application review and acceptance of an approved internship offer. Not included: site visits outside the Chicago area (if applicable), airfare and living costs, and other elective fees, so this may be incomplete.
